name: ClawMinutes
description: Local consent-based Teams recording and transcription. No participant joins the call.

notesModel.description: AI model for meeting notes, as provider/model. Leave unset to use the notes owner's primary model. Uses Gateway credentials; does not change speech recognition.

notesAgentId.description: Notes model credential owner. Defaults to the configured system agent; no tools or agent session are used.

notesModel.label: Notes model
notesModel.help: Choose an available Gateway model using provider/model. Leave unset to inherit the notes owner's primary model.

notesAgentId.label: Model credential owner
notesAgentId.help: The Gateway agent whose provider credentials are used. No agent session or tools are run.
